title: Login with Valid Credentials
preconditions: User has a registered account
steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Enter valid email and password. 3. Click Login.
expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.
actual_result: User logged in successfully.

title: Login with Invalid Credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: 1. Enter incorrect email or password. 2. Click Login.
expected_result: System rejects login and displays an error message.
actual_result: Error message displayed correctly.

title: View Available Courses
preconditions: Student is logged in and has an assigned program
steps: 1. Open course registration page. 2. Load sections for the student program.
expected_result: System displays only open courses for the student program.
actual_result: Courses displayed correctly.

title: View Class Information
preconditions: Available classes exist
steps: 1. Open course list. 2. Select/view a course section.
expected_result: Course name, lecturer, schedule, room, capacity, and price are displayed.
actual_result: All class information displayed correctly.

title: Register for Available Class
preconditions: Student is logged in; class is open, eligible, conflict-free, and has seats
steps: 1. Select an available class. 2. Click Register. 3. Confirm registration.
expected_result: Student is successfully registered; enrollment count increases and a confirmation notification is created.
actual_result: Service-level automated test confirms successful registration.

title: Reject Registration with Schedule Conflict
preconditions: Student is registered 08:00–10:00 Monday
expected_result: System rejects registration with schedule conflict.
actual_result: Automated service test rejects overlapping schedule.

title: Reject Registration When Class Is Full
preconditions: Class enrolled_count equals capacity
expected_result: System rejects registration with class-full message.
actual_result: Automated service test rejects full class.

title: View Registered Classes
preconditions: Student has at least one confirmed registration
expected_result: System displays all confirmed registered classes.
actual_result: Registered classes displayed correctly.

title: Cancel Course Registration
preconditions: Student has a registered class
steps: Open registered classes; select class; cancel; confirm.
expected_result: Registration is cancelled and the class seat becomes available.
actual_result: Dataset records Passed; source code review shows cancellation is not currently implemented.

title: Admin Creates New Class
preconditions: Administrator is logged in
steps: Open class management; add valid class; save.
expected_result: New class is created and displayed.
actual_result: Dataset records Passed; source code review shows admin class CRUD is not currently implemented.

title: Admin Edits Class Information
preconditions: Administrator is logged in and class exists
steps: Open class management; select class; edit information; save.
expected_result: Updated class information is saved and displayed correctly.
actual_result: Dataset records Passed; source code review shows class editing is not currently implemented.

title: Admin Cancels Class
preconditions: Administrator is logged in and class exists
steps: Select a class; cancel class; enter reason; confirm.
expected_result: Class status becomes cancelled and new registrations are disabled.
actual_result: Dataset records Passed; source code review shows class cancellation is not currently implemented.

title: Notify Students After Class Cancellation
preconditions: Class has registered students and is cancelled by admin
steps: Admin cancels the class; student opens notifications.
expected_result: All registered students receive a class cancellation notification.
actual_result: Dataset records Passed; source code review shows cancellation notification workflow is not implemented.

title: Verify User Role Permissions
preconditions: Student, lecturer, and admin accounts exist
steps: Login with each role and attempt restricted functions.
expected_result: Restricted functions are accessible only to authorized roles.
actual_result: API role dependencies exist; HTML admin/lecturer routes remain a known gap.

title: View Notifications
preconditions: User has at least one notification
expected_result: System displays the user notifications correctly.
actual_result: Dataset records Passed; source code review shows no notification list page/API is implemented.

title: Persist Registration Data
preconditions: Student can register for a class
steps: Register; query registration from database after commit.
expected_result: Stored registration remains available with correct student and section.
actual_result: Automated service test confirms persisted Registration record after commit.

title: Register New Student Account
preconditions: Program exists; email and student code are unique
steps: Open Register; enter valid data; submit.
expected_result: Student account is created with role student and session is established.
actual_result: Test case added from reviewer comment; execution pending.

title: Reject Duplicate Email During Registration
preconditions: An account already uses the email
steps: Submit registration using the same email.
expected_result: System redirects with Email already exists and does not create a second user.
actual_result: Test case added; source contains duplicate-email check.

title: Reject Duplicate Student Code
preconditions: An account already uses the student code
steps: Submit registration using the same student code.
expected_result: System redirects with Student code already exists and does not create a second user.
actual_result: Test case added; source contains duplicate-student-code check.

title: Logout Clears Active Session
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: Submit POST /auth/logout; then request protected page.
expected_result: Session is cleared, landing page is returned, and protected access requires authentication again.
actual_result: Test case added; source clears request.session.

title: Protected Page Requires Authentication
preconditions: No user_id exists in session
expected_result: System rejects unauthenticated request with HTTP 401 or configured login redirect.
actual_result: Test case added; get_current_user raises 401 without session.

title: View Student Dashboard Summary
preconditions: Student is logged in with confirmed registrations
expected_result: Dashboard displays current user and confirmed registrations.
actual_result: Test case added; source dashboard query reviewed.

title: View Own Profile
preconditions: Student is logged in
expected_result: Profile displays current user information.
actual_result: Test case added; source profile route reviewed.

title: Reject Duplicate Section Registration
preconditions: Student already has confirmed registration for the same section
steps: Attempt registration for same section again.
expected_result: System rejects request and creates no second registration.
actual_result: Automated test raised HTTP 400 with already registered message.

title: Reject Course Outside Student Program
preconditions: Selected section belongs to another academic program
expected_result: System rejects request with training-program eligibility message.
actual_result: Automated test raised HTTP 400 for wrong program.

title: Reject Closed Class Registration
preconditions: Selected section status is cancelled/closed
expected_result: System rejects request before creating registration.
actual_result: Automated test raised HTTP 400 for closed registration.

title: Adjacent Class Times Do Not Conflict
preconditions: Existing class 08:00–10:00; new class 10:00–12:00 on same day
expected_result: Registration succeeds because end time equals next start time without overlap.
actual_result: Automated boundary test passed.

title: Enrollment Count Increments Once
preconditions: Open section has enrolled_count=0
expected_result: enrolled_count becomes 1 exactly once.
actual_result: Automated test confirmed enrolled_count=1 after registration.

title: Registration Creates Confirmation Notification
preconditions: Student successfully completes registration
expected_result: A notification exists with success title and course information.
actual_result: Automated integration test confirmed notification creation.

title: Lecturer Views Assigned Sections
preconditions: Lecturer account has assigned course sections
expected_result: Only sections assigned to current lecturer are returned with timetable and capacity fields.
actual_result: Test case added; source endpoint and role dependency reviewed.

title: Lecturer Does Not See Another Lecturer Sections
preconditions: Two lecturer accounts have different assigned sections
expected_result: No section assigned only to lecturer B is returned.
actual_result: Test case added to cover data-scoping flow.

title: Admin Statistics Returns Correct Counts
preconditions: Admin account exists; database has known counts
expected_result: JSON counts match current User, Course and CourseSection totals.
actual_result: Test case added; source endpoint reviewed.

title: Student Is Denied Admin Statistics API
preconditions: Student account is authenticated
expected_result: System returns HTTP 403 Permission denied.
actual_result: Test case added; source require_role("admin") indicates expected 403.

title: Student Is Denied HTML Admin Page
preconditions: Student account is authenticated
expected_result: System should deny access or redirect away from admin page.
actual_result: Known gap: source review indicates the HTML /admin route does not apply the same admin role dependency as the statistics API; expected result is not yet demonstrated.

title: Registration Error Redirect Encodes Validation Message
preconditions: A registration request triggers a business validation exception
expected_result: System rolls back and redirects to /courses?error=<encoded message> without server error.
actual_result: Known bug candidate: source review identified a missing quote() import in the registration error redirect path; fix and execute regression test.
